{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(df))
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check sample_seq to see if higher sample_seq supersedes earlier ones
print("\nMax sample_seq per patient:")
max_seq = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(max_seq.value_counts())"}
